ip_top_stories.title: Publishers, Authors File Class Action Lawsuit Against Google [Metered]
ip_top_stories.summary: A new class action lawsuit has been filed by publishers and authors seeking to stop Google from using copyrighted works to train its AI models. The suit represents a significant escalation of litigation between the publishing industry and major AI developers over training data practices.

ip_top_stories.title: New York Times-Led Publishers Escalate Copyright Fight, Seek Court Sanctions Against OpenAI
ip_top_stories.summary: News outlets led by the New York Times have urged a judge to impose sanctions against OpenAI, alleging the company concealed or destroyed evidence in an ongoing high-stakes copyright dispute. The legal battle has already surpassed $28 million in costs, and the sanctions bid marks a significant escalation in the case.

ip_top_stories.title: Anthropic ties $21.6bn Australian investment to copyright certainty, as Canberra weighs AI reform
ip_top_stories.summary: Anthropic has formally linked a proposed $21.6 billion investment in Australia to the government providing legal clarity on AI copyright, lobbying the Albanese government directly on the issue. The Australian Prime Minister has indicated no urgency on reform, even as the deal and broader AI policy debate intensify pressure on Canberra.

ip_top_stories.title: Kenyan author who used AI loses copyright claim in landmark ruling
ip_top_stories.summary: A Kenyan tribunal has ruled that works generated by AI cannot be copyrighted, in what is being described as a landmark decision. The case involved a Kenyan author who used AI in creating their work and subsequently lost their copyright claim.

ip_top_stories.title: AI Music Training Hits Two Courts in July: Suno Faces Verdicts in Munich and Boston
ip_top_stories.summary: AI music generator Suno is facing simultaneous legal proceedings in both Munich and Boston during July, as major record labels press their copyright infringement claims in multiple jurisdictions. The cases are being closely watched as potential bellwethers for how courts will treat AI training on copyrighted audio content.

ip_further_links.title: OpenAI faces sanctions bid as copyright case escalates
ip_further_links.summary: OpenAI is facing a sanctions motion from news publisher plaintiffs who allege the company has improperly handled evidence in ongoing copyright litigation.

ip_further_links.title: 'Careless People' Author's Meta Suit Tests Power of Books Against Big Tech [Metered]
ip_further_links.summary: The copyright lawsuit filed by the author of 'Careless People' against Meta over AI training data is examined as a test case for how book-based claims may fare against major technology companies.

ip_further_links.title: From P. Ramlee to Taylor Swift, thousands of artists found in AI training datasets raising copyright concerns
ip_further_links.summary: An investigation has found thousands of artists — including Taylor Swift and the late P. Ramlee — whose work appears in AI training datasets, raising fresh copyright concerns across the music and creative industries.

ip_further_links.title: Easthampton author sues Anthropic over pirated book used to train AI
ip_further_links.summary: An author based in Easthampton has filed suit against Anthropic, alleging the company used a pirated copy of their book without authorisation as training data for its AI systems.

ip_further_links.title: Can AI Copyright Tools Be Manipulated? Delhi High Court Examines Suit Against Meta
ip_further_links.summary: The Delhi High Court is examining a case against Meta that questions whether AI-based copyright detection tools can be manipulated, raising novel questions about the reliability of automated rights enforcement.

ip_further_links.title: Midjourney Wants Hollywood to Reveal Its AI Use in 2026
ip_further_links.summary: AI image generator Midjourney is calling on Hollywood studios to publicly disclose their use of AI tools in film and television production.

ip_further_links.title: The NO FAKES Act Moves Forward: How AI Voice and Likeness Rights Could Reshape Entertainment Deals
ip_further_links.summary: An analysis of the advancing NO FAKES Act examines how proposed federal protections for AI-generated voice and likeness could significantly alter contract structures across the entertainment industry.

ip_further_links.title: Global AI Data Analytics Startups Promise Publishers an Edge [Metered]
ip_further_links.summary: A new wave of AI-driven data analytics startups is pitching publishers on tools designed to help them better track and monetise their content in the age of AI training.

ip_further_links.title: Suno, sued by major labels, says 'transparency is important' as record industry proposes AI labeling system
ip_further_links.summary: Suno has commented on transparency as the recording industry advances a proposal for an AI content labelling system, amid ongoing litigation with major labels over AI music generation.

ip_further_links.title: Guest Post — Research Needs a Shared Standard for AI Disclosure
ip_further_links.summary: A guest post on The Scholarly Kitchen argues that the academic research community urgently needs a unified, shared standard for disclosing the use of AI in published research.
